description: This file defines a factory class for the 'metadata' package within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides static methods to create, parse, and retrieve instances of various metadata header-related classes, encapsulating implementation details and facilitating object creation.

classes.name: MetadataPackageFactory
classes.description: A utility factory class providing static methods to create and parse metadata header objects within the 'metadata' package.

methods.name: getMetadataHeader
methods.description: Creates a DefaultMetadataHeader instance using a key and a JSON value.

methods.name: metadataHeaderFromJson
methods.description: Parses a JsonObject to produce a MetadataHeader instance.

methods.name: parseMetadataHeaderKey
methods.description: Parses a character sequence to produce a DefaultMetadataHeaderKey.

methods.name: getMetadataHeaderKey
methods.description: Creates a DefaultMetadataHeaderKey from a JsonPointer.

methods.name: parseMetadataHeaders
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence representing metadata headers into a MetadataHeaders object.

methods.name: newMetadataHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MetadataHeaders.
